text: The Flame of the Exodar is obtained when a Horde character clicks on the Midsummer Flame in the Exodar.

Flash pods are a tinker invention inspired by the lights used in the night elf village of Nighthaven. Inside a a flash pod's wooden shell is a small charge of gunpowder and two compartments containing the secretions of phosphorescent insects of Ashenvale Forest. After the quick-burning fuse of a flash pod has been lit, the gunpowder detonates. The explosion both deals damage to anyone within 5 feet, and allows the secretions inside to combine, and ignites them in a blinding flash.

Flasks are a consumable item similar to Elixirs which enhance particular a player for a period of time upon being consumed. They differ in that the effects do not disapear upon death and they count as both a Battle and Guardian Elixir simultaneously. The effect of a flask is typically stronger than elixirs which are introduced in the same expansion, making them attractive for end-game PvE and PvP content. Though an individual flask may cost more than an elixir, they are often preferred because the effect of elixirs may expire quickly due to death. Flesh-Shaper Arnauld is a Forsaken quest giver located in the Sludge Fields in Hillsbrad Foothills. He sends Horde adventurers to bring him Flesh Samples from the Risen Hillsbrad Farmers and claims that they will grant him a better understanding of the mindless undead in the fields. When Master Apothecary Lydon confronts the traitorous Warden Stillwater, Arnauld comes to his aid and is subsequently killed. Despite this, during the Legion Invasions, he was mind-controlled by a nathrezim but freed by the adventurers. He was surprised to see blood and wanted to warn the rest.

Flesh Spawn are shadowy fleshbeasts found in the Tomb of Tyr in the Tirisfal Glades. During Blade in Twilight, a pack of them spawns after each Twilight Ritualist is killed, and several more can be found roaming the Darkwalk. During The Sword of Kings, three packs of them roam around the Vestibule of the Silver Hand just outside the entrance to the Tomb proper.

Flayers' Point, sometimes referred to as "Slayers' Point" due to the danger, is a trading post on the coast of Desolace that is not located on any maps. It started as a skinning camp and evolved into its current status as a busy but isolated trading post for the locals of Desolace, as well as the rare trader who knows enough to come ashore. While at any given time there are a handful of individuals from various races at Flayers' Point, they are far outnumbered by the common tauren, centaur, and quilboar.
